{{Quote|Open up in there! Open up in there!|Stormtrooper officer|<ref name="ANH" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]], he served in the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]] during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].

==Biography==
In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], he was stationed onboard the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] where he led a patrol towards [[Docking Control Room 327]] which was run by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Pol Treidum/Legends|Pol Treidum]]. After losing contact from Treidum, the stormtrooper found the door to the control room locked and demanded anyone inside to open it. He then ordered his troopers to have unlock the doors and make a full sweep across the control room. Finding nothing, he and his troops heard the sound of knocking from a closet and found the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], who were pretending that they were being locked away by rebels. Not knowing that these were the droids the Empire was looking for, the officer ordered his patrol to move towards Level 5 and left [[Unidentified stormtrooper 3 (Death Star)|one stormtrooper]] to stay on guard of the control room.<ref name="ANH" />
